From its secluded location - a rich and diverse mosaic of ecosystems – the resort’s clifftop restaurants and pool, lakeside Aman Spa and private golden sand beach, offer limitless opportunities for outdoor exploration, cultural immersion and serene time out. Accommodation Pavilions & Villas Opening onto expansive wooden decks, many with swimming pools, Pavilions & Villas offer breathtaking views of the sea or rolling hills. Accommodation Residences At one with their magnificent natural settings, the fully serviced Residences offer up to five bedrooms and vast infinity pools. View all accommodation Book now Exclusive Offer Extend Your Stay A complimentary night with stays of four nights or more, daily breakfast and return airport transfers from Cam Ranh Airport. Discover more Dining Fragrant flavours The restaurants at Amanoi celebrate the fragrant flavours of Vietnamese cuisine, making the most of seasonal market produce and the daily catch. Discover more Experiences What's on at Amanoi Celebrate the very best of each season on Vietnam’s dramatic coastline with Amanoi’s one-off programme of ever-changing events and experiences. Discover more experience Wellness Pool Villa Experience Amanoi’s two unique Wellness Pool Villas are designed for those who wish to dedicate their stay to wellness. Enjoy treatments, therapies and movement classes in consummate privacy without leaving the waterside Lake Wellness Pool Villa or the secluded Forest Wellness Pool Villa. Discover more Celebrations Host the perfect event Embraced by a spectacularly beautiful wilderness on a stretch of dramatic coastline, Amanoi offers a plethora of settings both indoors and out for the most exclusive weddings and celebrations in Vietnam. Discover more Getting here Amanoi is a 75-minute drive from Cam Ranh Airport (CXR). By air, Cam Ranh is 65 minutes from Ho Chi Minh City, 75 minutes from Da Nang or 105 minutes from Hanoi. Travel from 5 hours by car from Ho Chi Minh City to Amanoi via the highway. Direct international flights to Cam Ranh Airport (CXR) from Singapore, Bangkok, Seoul, Busan, Kuala Lumpur, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Haikou and Phnom Penh. Our multilingual reservations team is always available to help with travel planning, from booking a single night to multi-resort itineraries.
